mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND role_id = #{role}) AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise_invitation WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND JSON_CONTAINS(role_ids_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{role})) AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > #{now}) AS pending_invitations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_policy WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND subject_type = 'role' AND subject_id = #{role}) AS quota_policies, 0 AS resource_grants

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise_team_member WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND team_id = #{team}) AS members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise_invitation WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND JSON_CONTAINS(team_ids_json, JSON_QUOTE(#{team})) AND status = 'pending' AND expires_at > #{now}) AS pending_invitations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_policy WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND subject_type = 'team' AND subject_id = #{team}) AS quota_policies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_grant WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND subject_type = 'team' AND subject_id = #{team}) AS resource_grants
